### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

# At the Intersection of Innovation & Expertise

PPG’s Traffic Solutions business offers industry-leading pavement markings with world-class
technical expertise that brings safety to the forefront.

[ENNIS-FLINT® by PPG preformed thermoplastic]

## Industry Segments


Whether you’re marking and coating roads, runways, pedestrian areas or the other routes people take
through our world, PPG has the products, expertise and service to meet your unique needs and
specifications. From highly durable and reliable products that deliver industry-leading performance
to continual innovation and service & technical support, we can go further for you.

View Industry Segments

## Our Products


The ENNIS-FLINT® by PPG family of products are engineered, manufactured and supplied to provide
optimal performance, lasting value and to extend the life of your unique marking program. From
traditional paints, high-performance formulas and plural components for road and highway striping to
preformed thermoplastic for transverse markings and heavy-duty intersections, custom horizontal
surface signage and more, PPG has the comprehensive offering to meet any need.

View Products
[ENNIS-FLINT® by PPG THERMODROP® hot-applied thermoplastic]
[ENNIS-FLINT® by PPG STIMSONITE® Raised Pavement Markers]

## For Your Application


We understand that every application requires products designed to meet your required
specifications. Our products are found throughout the globe on highways, taxiways, runways, parking
lots and in all kinds of commercial, contractor, governmental, industrial, airport and architectural
settings because we know how to meet our customers’ unique needs with exceptional performance and
world class service and support.

View Solutions

## Technical Service


PPG’s Traffic Solutions business doesn’t just offer exceptional products to meet your unique needs.
To help you ensure successful application on your project, we offer application training and
after-sales support that has been recognized as some of the industry’s best. Our unparalleled
network of technical service professionals will be there to help maximize uptime to help you improve
productivity.

Learn More

# At the Intersection of Innovation & Expertise

PPG’s Traffic Solutions business offers industry-leading pavement markings with world-class
technical expertise that brings safety to the forefront.

[ENNIS-FLINT® by PPG preformed thermoplastic]

## Industry Segments


Whether you’re marking and coating roads, runways, pedestrian areas or the other routes people take
through our world, PPG has the products, expertise and service to meet your unique needs and
specifications. From highly durable and reliable products that deliver industry-leading performance
to continual innovation and service & technical support, we can go further for you.

View Industry Segments

## Our Products


The ENNIS-FLINT® by PPG family of products are engineered, manufactured and supplied to provide
optimal performance, lasting value and to extend the life of your unique marking program. From
traditional paints, high-performance formulas and plural components for road and highway striping to
preformed thermoplastic for transverse markings and heavy-duty intersections, custom horizontal
surface signage and more, PPG has the comprehensive offering to meet any need.

View Products
[ENNIS-FLINT® by PPG THERMODROP® hot-applied thermoplastic]
[ENNIS-FLINT® by PPG STIMSONITE® Raised Pavement Markers]

## For Your Application


We understand that every application requires products designed to meet your required
specifications. Our products are found throughout the globe on highways, taxiways, runways, parking
lots and in all kinds of commercial, contractor, governmental, industrial, airport and architectural
settings because we know how to meet our customers’ unique needs with exceptional performance and
world class service and support.

View Solutions

## Technical Service


PPG’s Traffic Solutions business doesn’t just offer exceptional products to meet your unique needs.
To help you ensure successful application on your project, we offer application training and
after-sales support that has been recognized as some of the industry’s best. Our unparalleled
network of technical service professionals will be there to help maximize uptime to help you improve
productivity.

## RoadSafe Capabilities

The nation’s leader in traffic safety and pavement marking provides industry-wide services and
comprehensive product lines to contractors, engineering firms, DOTs, local municipalities, telecom &
utility providers, and other traffic control & pavement marking operators.

[Traffic Control Services]

### Traffic Control
### Services

RoadSafe has decades of experience in traffic control services and can offer solutions and traffic
control plans that meet any work zone requirements from flagging to highway or street lane closures.

[Pavement Marking & Material Sales]

### Pavement Marking &
### Material Sales

Our expert crews are nationwide and are dedicated to providing the highest level of service on the
highway, streets, and roadways we also travel. For service providers, we’d be happy to support just
about any of your material needs. 

[Sign Manufacturing & Installation]

### Sign Manufacturing
### & Installation

We specialize in traffic control, street, overhead guide signs, and commercial signage. As 3M
certified providers of MUTCD-compliant signage, our network of sign fabricators can support you with
just about any project.

[Safety Equipment & Supplies]

### Safety Equipment
### & Supplies

Our locations can provide rentals and sales for variable message signs, arrow boards, speed
trailers, crash cushions, drums, barricades, traffic signs, PPE, traffic paint, thermoplastic
pavement markings, and much more.

[Special Events]

### Special
### Events

We deliver safety solutions for some of the largest events in sports, music, and festivals
nationwide. Our experience enables us to provide the best traffic control practices. 

[Smart Work Zone & Technology Driven Solutions]

### Smart Work Zone & Technology Driven Solutions

Technology is advancing quickly with Waze-connected real-time traffic sensors, sequential lighting,
and Automated Flagging Devices (AFAD). We at RoadSafe are dedicated to using and offering these
high-tech solutions for effective results.

RoadSafe is the premier provider of expert traffic control services, flagging, pavement marking

## About Us

Safety Is the
Foundation of RoadSafe

At RoadSafe, we put safety first - from supplying spec-ready traffic control plans & pavement
marking solutions to providing [NSC award-winning training programs][67] for our crews. Even our
meetings start with a safety moment. Our goal is simple. To help maintain a safer environment for
drivers, workers, & pedestrians on roadways we all share. RoadSafe offers industry-leading coverage
of traffic safety and pavement marking services and products across the U.S. With 60+ locations
nationwide, our growing network is ready to support your operations wherever you need us.

[
More About Us
][68]
[Safety Is the Foundation of RoadSafe]

## Locations

National Presence
Local Expertise

RoadSafe offers industry-leading coverage of traffic safety and pavement marking services & products
in the U.S. Leverage our growing network of 60+ branches to support your operations.

Explore the interactive map below

## Follow the RoadSafe Signs to Safety

Smart work zones, expert traffic control, clear roadway signs, and high-quality pavement marking
help keep drivers, pedestrians, and crews moving safely.

[Safety Compliance]

### Safety Compliance

Our training and equipment comply with industry standards, and our technology-driven safety program
is embedded in our operations.

[Smart Work Zone Tech]

### Smart Work Zone Tech

Dynamic messaging & signs put safety and visibility at the forefront with intelligent traffic
solutions. 

[Emergency & Storm Response]

### Emergency & Storm Response

When emergencies occur, we stand ready to support with well-practiced and drilled crisis and storm
management procedures, mobilizing extra crew when needed.

[Industry Leader in Traffic & Work Zone Safety]

### Industry Leader in Traffic & Work Zone Safety

Our services and products meet industry standards because we help maintain roadway safety above all
else. 

[ATSSA Member]

### ATSSA Member

As a proud member and contributor to the American Traffic Safety Services Association, we share
their commitment  to work zone & traffic safety.

## RoadSafe Capabilities

The nation’s leader in traffic safety and pavement marking provides industry-wide services and
comprehensive product lines to contractors, engineering firms, DOTs, local municipalities, telecom &
utility providers, and other traffic control & pavement marking operators.

[Traffic Control Services]

### Traffic Control
### Services

RoadSafe has decades of experience in traffic control services and can offer solutions and traffic
control plans that meet any work zone requirements from flagging to highway or street lane closures.

[Pavement Marking & Material Sales]

### Pavement Marking &
### Material Sales

Our expert crews are nationwide and are dedicated to providing the highest level of service on the
highway, streets, and roadways we also travel. For service providers, we’d be happy to support just
about any of your material needs. 

[Sign Manufacturing & Installation]

### Sign Manufacturing
### & Installation

We specialize in traffic control, street, overhead guide signs, and commercial signage. As 3M
certified providers of MUTCD-compliant signage, our network of sign fabricators can support you with
just about any project.

[Safety Equipment & Supplies]

### Safety Equipment
### & Supplies

Our locations can provide rentals and sales for variable message signs, arrow boards, speed
trailers, crash cushions, drums, barricades, traffic signs, PPE, traffic paint, thermoplastic
pavement markings, and much more.

[Special Events]

### Special
### Events

We deliver safety solutions for some of the largest events in sports, music, and festivals
nationwide. Our experience enables us to provide the best traffic control practices. 

[Smart Work Zone & Technology Driven Solutions]

### Smart Work Zone & Technology Driven Solutions

Technology is advancing quickly with Waze-connected real-time traffic sensors, sequential lighting,
and Automated Flagging Devices (AFAD). We at RoadSafe are dedicated to using and offering these
high-tech solutions for effective results.

identify risks, and define safety requirements before recommending appropriate solutions.

### Customized Safety Solutions

We develop tailored safety systems, including traffic signs, road marking, road studs, and signaling
solutions, designed in accordance with international standards and project specifications.

### Manufacturing & Installation

Utilizing high-performance materials and specialized equipment, we manufacture and install safety
systems with precision, efficiency, and strict quality assurance procedures.

### Testing, Delivery & Ongoing Support

All systems undergo performance verification to ensure visibility, durability, and operational
reliability, followed by on-time project delivery and continuous technical support.

We are the biggest EPC contractor in Egyptian market specialized In road safety since 1996.

effective and reliable road safety solutions from start to finish.

Our team conducts comprehensive site inspections and traffic evaluations to assess road conditions,
identify risks, and define safety requirements before recommending appropriate solutions.

### Customized Safety Solutions

We develop tailored safety systems, including traffic signs, road marking, road studs, and signaling
solutions, designed in accordance with international standards and project specifications.

### Manufacturing & Installation

Utilizing high-performance materials and specialized equipment, we manufacture and install safety
systems with precision, efficiency, and strict quality assurance procedures.

### Testing, Delivery & Ongoing Support

All systems undergo performance verification to ensure visibility, durability, and operational
reliability, followed by on-time project delivery and continuous technical support.

> Our company has been a steady customer of Crown Technology, LLC for over 16 years. From the

> We have been a steady customer of Crown Technology, LLC for over 16 years.  From the beginning, we

> I am impressed with the quicker application and flow rate of the preformed material. It seems like

> The Tuff-Mark is performing well on concrete AND asphalt applications.  It melts fast, bonds well,

Got Questions?

## Frequently Asked Questions

▸  What types of crash barriers does DG Group manufacture?

DG Group manufactures **W-Beam crash barriers**, **Thrie-Beam barriers**, and crash-tested road
safety systems. All products are certified to European **TB11** (heavy vehicle) and **TB42**
(passenger vehicle) crash test standards, fully compliant with MORTH and NHAI highway
specifications.

▸  Where are DG Group's manufacturing plants located?

DG Group operates **3 manufacturing plants** in Satara district, Maharashtra — two units in
**Karad** and one in **Lonand**. All facilities are strategically located near the **Pune–Bangalore
NH48 Highway** for seamless Pan-India supply and logistics.

▸  Does DG Group provide hot-dip galvanizing services?

Yes. DG Group provides industrial **hot-dip galvanizing** for structural steel, fabricated
components, pipes, and highway infrastructure products at its Karad plant. The service covers
large-scale projects for highway contractors, construction companies, and infrastructure developers
across India.

▸  What certifications do DG Group crash barriers carry?

DG Group crash barriers are certified under the **European EN 1317 standard** — **TB11** (tested
against heavy trucks) and **TB42** (tested against passenger cars). These are the highest crash test
certifications mandated by NHAI for national highways and expressways in India.

▸  Does DG Group supply to NHAI and state PWD projects?

Yes. DG Group is an approved supplier for **NHAI**, state PWD highway projects, and private EPC
contractors across India. Products meet all **MORTH specifications** and IRC standards. Contact
[marketing@dggroupcompanies.com][15] for project-specific pricing and delivery.

▸  How many years of experience does DG Group have?

DG Group of Companies was established in **2008** and brings **16+ years of experience** in
manufacturing crash barriers, hot-dip galvanizing, octagonal poles, and transmission line products.
The company has supplied to hundreds of highway projects across Maharashtra, Karnataka, Goa, and
other states.

▸  What is D G Road Safety Pvt Ltd and how is it related to DG Group?

**D G Road Safety Pvt Ltd** is the installation arm of DG Group of Companies. While **D G
Constructions** manufactures crash barriers, D G Road Safety Pvt Ltd handles project contracts and
installation of crash barriers on highways and bridges. Together, they offer complete
**supply-and-install contracts** — manufacturing and erecting crash barriers for NHAI, state PWD,
and private EPC projects across India. This integrated model ensures quality, speed, and cost
efficiency.

Got Questions?

## Frequently Asked Questions

▸  What types of crash barriers does DG Group manufacture?

DG Group manufactures **W-Beam crash barriers**, **Thrie-Beam barriers**, and crash-tested road
safety systems. All products are certified to European **TB11** (heavy vehicle) and **TB42**
(passenger vehicle) crash test standards, fully compliant with MORTH and NHAI highway
specifications.

▸  Where are DG Group's manufacturing plants located?

DG Group operates **3 manufacturing plants** in Satara district, Maharashtra — two units in
**Karad** and one in **Lonand**. All facilities are strategically located near the **Pune–Bangalore
NH48 Highway** for seamless Pan-India supply and logistics.

▸  Does DG Group provide hot-dip galvanizing services?

Yes. DG Group provides industrial **hot-dip galvanizing** for structural steel, fabricated
components, pipes, and highway infrastructure products at its Karad plant. The service covers
large-scale projects for highway contractors, construction companies, and infrastructure developers
across India.

▸  What certifications do DG Group crash barriers carry?

DG Group crash barriers are certified under the **European EN 1317 standard** — **TB11** (tested
against heavy trucks) and **TB42** (tested against passenger cars). These are the highest crash test
certifications mandated by NHAI for national highways and expressways in India.

▸  Does DG Group supply to NHAI and state PWD projects?

Yes. DG Group is an approved supplier for **NHAI**, state PWD highway projects, and private EPC
contractors across India. Products meet all **MORTH specifications** and IRC standards. Contact
[marketing@dggroupcompanies.com][15] for project-specific pricing and delivery.

▸  How many years of experience does DG Group have?

DG Group of Companies was established in **2008** and brings **16+ years of experience** in
manufacturing crash barriers, hot-dip galvanizing, octagonal poles, and transmission line products.
The company has supplied to hundreds of highway projects across Maharashtra, Karnataka, Goa, and
other states.

▸  What is D G Road Safety Pvt Ltd and how is it related to DG Group?

**D G Road Safety Pvt Ltd** is the installation arm of DG Group of Companies. While **D G
Constructions** manufactures crash barriers, D G Road Safety Pvt Ltd handles project contracts and
installation of crash barriers on highways and bridges. Together, they offer complete
**supply-and-install contracts** — manufacturing and erecting crash barriers for NHAI, state PWD,
and private EPC projects across India. This integrated model ensures quality, speed, and cost
efficiency.

  **#3 Hot Product** AC-STM-I/II driving-type thermoplastic screeding road marking machine, small
  and compact, easy operation. It is the optimal equipment for road line marking in medium or large
  urban road. Type I: pneumatic screeding flat line marking shoe. Type II: pneumatic screeding flat
  or convex line marking shoe.
  
  [Read More][23]

  **#4 Hot Product** AC-BTSC-I/II is a professional road marking machine with high efficiency, and
  suitable for marking highway, urban road and local road with large construction square. Type I:
  pneumatic screeding flat line marking shoe. Type II: pneumatic screeding flat or convex line
  marking shoe.
  
  [Read More][24]

  Trevors: [www.jtrevors.com][25]
  
  [Read More][26]

  automatic marking equipment ([AC-STM][28]) and two thermoplastic paint preheaters ([AC-VHDP][29])
  from us to establish a section within their company's road construction division in 2012.
  
  [Read More][30]

  No matter where you are, we are on your side. ACE road marking machines have been exported to more

MERISTEMA-N LLC

Meristema-N is a research and production company and an innovative developer in the agricultural
sector. We specialize in creating natural humic complexes and restoring soil fertility.

«Meristin» is a concentrated peat gel with a high content of humic and fulvic acids. It improves
soil structure, enhances moisture retention, and stimulates root system development. The product
strengthens plants' natural immunity, neutralizes excess acids, and supports beneficial microflora

Biotechnology

MERISTEMA-N LLC

Meristema-N is a research and production company and an innovative developer in the agricultural
sector. We specialize in creating natural humic complexes and restoring soil fertility.

«Meristin» is a concentrated peat gel with a high content of humic and fulvic acids. It improves
soil structure, enhances moisture retention, and stimulates root system development. The product
strengthens plants' natural immunity, neutralizes excess acids, and supports beneficial microflora
development, leading to increased crop yields and soil restoration.

«Meristin-N» products have already gained recognition in horticulture, agriculture, and
biotechnology, demonstrating high efficiency and versatility across various applications.

## Remarkable projects

Markings really do make a difference. From colourful playgrounds and creative community spaces to
safer roads and accessible parking areas - these real-life projects show how our materials help turn
ideas into practical, everyday improvements. Each application supports safer, more sustainable, and
efficient mobility, proving that even small changes on the surface can have a lasting impact on how
we move through our shared spaces.

### Leading the way to accesibility

[TacGuide™ lead the way for the visually impaired]

The Danish municipality of Fredericia has expanded pathways for the visually impaired using our
durable TacGuide™ material.

[Read more][86]

### Playful and practical pathway

[Playful markings lead the way in Billund]

Our marking materials bring both fun and function to life - guiding visitors to attractions and
facilities in the heart of Billund, Denmark.

[Read more][87]

### Enhancing safety at London station

[PREMARK™ safe-proofs London railway station]

Finding a durable solution for safety signage for one of London's busiest train stations was of
crucial importance.

[Read more][88]

### High visibility in Italy

[PREMARK™ Vizibility in Florence, Italy]

Visibility and safety go hand in hand on the streets of Florence, thanks to the application of
PREMARK™ Vizibility.

[Read more][89]

## Spotlight: Parking solutions

[Featuring parking infrastructure subject geveko markings]

Parking areas do more than provide a place to leave a car - they help organise traffic, improve
safety, and ensure accessibility. With clear markings you can reduce congestion, prevent accidents,
and make parking easier for all.

[Read more][90]

## Spotlight: Repair & prevent

[Featuring road and surface repair subject geveko markings]

Whether you are handling routine maintenance or urgent fixes, our products help you restore a
variety of surfaces with minimal effort and downtime. Effective repairs – anytime, anywhere.

[Read more][91]

## Spotlight: Cycling infrastructure

[Featuring micromobility subject geveko markings]

The right markings make cycling safer, more accessible, and more inviting for everyone. Dedicated
lanes, clear symbols, and high-visibility materials help protect vulnerable road users and improve
flow in busy urban areas.

[Read more][92]

## Why work with us?

[ Why work with us? ][93]

### Superior quality

We take the quality of our products and operations seriously. All of our sites are ISO9001 certified
and our formulations and processes ensure products perform consistently to specified requirements
and expectations.

### Strong product portfolio

With our full range of products and solutions, we cover all your marking needs. By having one
professional main supplier of marking materials, you can focus your time and efforts on managing and
growing your business.

### More than 100 years of experience

With over a century of experience, we have a long history and deep knowledge of the road markings
industry that we use every day to our customers’ advantage.

### Local presence

Our sales and technical teams stay closely connected to local requirements and evolving market
trends. This ensures we understand your needs and can support your business and journey with
tailored solutions.

### Global supply chain

With a flexible distribution setup, we ensure fast and reliable deliveries across all our key
markets. Our production network and strong supplier relationships provide us with the stability and
adaptability required to meet customer demands.

## Remarkable projects

Markings really do make a difference. From colourful playgrounds and creative community spaces to
safer roads and accessible parking areas - these real-life projects show how our materials help turn
ideas into practical, everyday improvements. Each application supports safer, more sustainable, and
efficient mobility, proving that even small changes on the surface can have a lasting impact on how
we move through our shared spaces.

### Leading the way to accesibility

[TacGuide™ lead the way for the visually impaired]

The Danish municipality of Fredericia has expanded pathways for the visually impaired using our
durable TacGuide™ material.

[Read more][86]

### Playful and practical pathway

[Playful markings lead the way in Billund]

Our marking materials bring both fun and function to life - guiding visitors to attractions and
facilities in the heart of Billund, Denmark.

[Read more][87]

### Enhancing safety at London station

[PREMARK™ safe-proofs London railway station]

Finding a durable solution for safety signage for one of London's busiest train stations was of
crucial importance.

[Read more][88]

### High visibility in Italy

[PREMARK™ Vizibility in Florence, Italy]

Visibility and safety go hand in hand on the streets of Florence, thanks to the application of
PREMARK™ Vizibility.

[Read more][89]

## Spotlight: Parking solutions

[Featuring parking infrastructure subject geveko markings]

Parking areas do more than provide a place to leave a car - they help organise traffic, improve
safety, and ensure accessibility. With clear markings you can reduce congestion, prevent accidents,
and make parking easier for all.

[Read more][90]

## Spotlight: Repair & prevent

[Featuring road and surface repair subject geveko markings]

Whether you are handling routine maintenance or urgent fixes, our products help you restore a
variety of surfaces with minimal effort and downtime. Effective repairs – anytime, anywhere.

[Read more][91]

## Spotlight: Cycling infrastructure

[Featuring micromobility subject geveko markings]

The right markings make cycling safer, more accessible, and more inviting for everyone. Dedicated
lanes, clear symbols, and high-visibility materials help protect vulnerable road users and improve
flow in busy urban areas.

[Read more][92]

## Why work with us?

[ Why work with us? ][93]

### Superior quality

We take the quality of our products and operations seriously. All of our sites are ISO9001 certified
and our formulations and processes ensure products perform consistently to specified requirements
and expectations.

### Strong product portfolio

With our full range of products and solutions, we cover all your marking needs. By having one
professional main supplier of marking materials, you can focus your time and efforts on managing and
growing your business.

### More than 100 years of experience

With over a century of experience, we have a long history and deep knowledge of the road markings
industry that we use every day to our customers’ advantage.

### Local presence

Our sales and technical teams stay closely connected to local requirements and evolving market
trends. This ensures we understand your needs and can support your business and journey with
tailored solutions.

### Global supply chain

With a flexible distribution setup, we ensure fast and reliable deliveries across all our key
markets. Our production network and strong supplier relationships provide us with the stability and
adaptability required to meet customer demands.

# HOFMANN ROAD MARKING SYSTEMS

## **Wer wir sind**

HOFMANN ist ein international führender Hersteller von Maschinen und Systemen für
Straßenmarkierungen. Seit unserer Gründung in Deutschland vor 75 Jahren, war es schon immer unser
Ziel maximale Zuverlässigkeit, Haltbarkeit und Sicherheit für unsere Produkte zu gewährleisten.
 

## **Was wir machen**

Unser [Produktsortiment][59] beinhaltet alles, was für Straßenmarkierungen notwendig ist: Von
kleinen, hand-gesteuerten [Straßenmarkierungsmaschinen ][60]bis hin zu Straßenmarkierung-Trucks für
eine intensive industrielle Nutzung. Wir stellen jedoch nicht nur Maschinen bereit, sondern
unterstützen bei der Wartung und beraten Sie mit unserer umfangreichen Erfahrung. Seit Jahren findet
die [HOFMANN Expo][61] statt - ein Forum zur Kommunikation zwischen unterschiedlichsten Gruppen im
Bereich der Straßenmarkierung – Markierungsmaterialhersteller und Ministerialstellen,
Straßenmarkierer und wissenschaftlichen Lehrbeauftragten.

## **Unsere Einsatzgebiete**

Systeme für Straßenmarkierungen von HOFMANN werden in vielen verschiedenen Bereichen und Branchen
eingesetzt. Nicht nur für Straßen, sondern auch für [Flughafenmarkierungen][62],
Baustellenmarkierungen und Parkplatzmarkierungen nutzen unsere Kunden Markiermaschinen von HOFMANN.
Für unsere Kunden stellen wir individuelle und ökonomische Lösungen bereit. [Kontaktieren Sie
uns][63] und sprechen Sie direkt mit unseren Experten.
 

## **Länder in denen wir vertreten sind**

Wir stellen unseren Service in Kooperation mit unseren [Partnern][64] weltweit bereit. Um
herauszufinden welcher Partner Ihrer Region am nächsten ist, prüfen Sie unser [globales
Netzwerk][65]. Unsere Firmenzentrale befindet sich in Rellingen, in der Nähe von Hamburg.

## [Angebote][75]

Seit 1952 ist HOFMANN als führender Hersteller der Partner für Markiertechnik. Das Produktprogramm
umfasst von kleinen, handgeführten Maschinen bis zum Markier-LKW alles, was für Fahrbahnmarkierungen
benötigt wird. Auf speziellen Kundenwunsch entwickelte Problemlösungen sind für uns eine
Herausforderung.

Dabei profitiert der Anwender vom regen Kontakt HOFMANNs zu Theorie und Praxis: seit Jahren finden
die HOFMANN Technologie­ Tage statt – ein Forum zur Kommunikation zwischen unterschiedlichsten
Gruppen im Bereich der Straßenmarkierung - Materialhersteller und Behörden, Straßenmarkierer und
wissenschaftlichen Lehrbeauftragten.

Es stehen Applikationssysteme für alle verwendeten Markierungsstoffe zur Verfügung. Wegabhängige,
dosierende AMAKOS^{®} -Systeme für die wirtschaftliche Verarbeitung von Markierungsstoffen –
entwickelt im Hause HOFMANN – runden das Produktprogramm ab.

# HOFMANN ROAD MARKING SYSTEMS

## **Wer wir sind**

HOFMANN ist ein international führender Hersteller von Maschinen und Systemen für
Straßenmarkierungen. Seit unserer Gründung in Deutschland vor 75 Jahren, war es schon immer unser
Ziel maximale Zuverlässigkeit, Haltbarkeit und Sicherheit für unsere Produkte zu gewährleisten.
 

## **Was wir machen**

Unser [Produktsortiment][59] beinhaltet alles, was für Straßenmarkierungen notwendig ist: Von
kleinen, hand-gesteuerten [Straßenmarkierungsmaschinen ][60]bis hin zu Straßenmarkierung-Trucks für
eine intensive industrielle Nutzung. Wir stellen jedoch nicht nur Maschinen bereit, sondern
unterstützen bei der Wartung und beraten Sie mit unserer umfangreichen Erfahrung. Seit Jahren findet
die [HOFMANN Expo][61] statt - ein Forum zur Kommunikation zwischen unterschiedlichsten Gruppen im
Bereich der Straßenmarkierung – Markierungsmaterialhersteller und Ministerialstellen,
Straßenmarkierer und wissenschaftlichen Lehrbeauftragten.

## **Unsere Einsatzgebiete**

Systeme für Straßenmarkierungen von HOFMANN werden in vielen verschiedenen Bereichen und Branchen
eingesetzt. Nicht nur für Straßen, sondern auch für [Flughafenmarkierungen][62],
Baustellenmarkierungen und Parkplatzmarkierungen nutzen unsere Kunden Markiermaschinen von HOFMANN.
Für unsere Kunden stellen wir individuelle und ökonomische Lösungen bereit. [Kontaktieren Sie
uns][63] und sprechen Sie direkt mit unseren Experten.
 

## **Länder in denen wir vertreten sind**

Wir stellen unseren Service in Kooperation mit unseren [Partnern][64] weltweit bereit. Um
herauszufinden welcher Partner Ihrer Region am nächsten ist, prüfen Sie unser [globales
Netzwerk][65]. Unsere Firmenzentrale befindet sich in Rellingen, in der Nähe von Hamburg.

## [Angebote][75]

Seit 1952 ist HOFMANN als führender Hersteller der Partner für Markiertechnik. Das Produktprogramm
umfasst von kleinen, handgeführten Maschinen bis zum Markier-LKW alles, was für Fahrbahnmarkierungen
benötigt wird. Auf speziellen Kundenwunsch entwickelte Problemlösungen sind für uns eine
Herausforderung.

Dabei profitiert der Anwender vom regen Kontakt HOFMANNs zu Theorie und Praxis: seit Jahren finden
die HOFMANN Technologie­ Tage statt – ein Forum zur Kommunikation zwischen unterschiedlichsten
Gruppen im Bereich der Straßenmarkierung - Materialhersteller und Behörden, Straßenmarkierer und
wissenschaftlichen Lehrbeauftragten.

Es stehen Applikationssysteme für alle verwendeten Markierungsstoffe zur Verfügung. Wegabhängige,
dosierende AMAKOS^{®} -Systeme für die wirtschaftliche Verarbeitung von Markierungsstoffen –
entwickelt im Hause HOFMANN – runden das Produktprogramm ab.

  Complete removal of trees, brush, and heavy understory to deliver a pad-ready site that meets
  county and LCRA guidelines.
* **Cedar Clearing**
  Specialized extraction of dense cedar breaks—lower wildfire fuel loads, restore native grasses,
  and reclaim hilltop views.
* **Forestry Mulching**
  Single-operator skid-steer mulching head turns woody debris into onsite mulch, improving soil
  moisture and eliminating haul-off fees.
* **Stump Grinding**
  Carbide-tipped grinders flush stumps 4–6″ below surface; prevents regrowth and readies ground for
  foundations or fencing.
* **Ranch & Pasture Clearing**
  Custom plans for working ranches: clear senderos, expand grazing corridors, and maintain habitat
  edges for game management.

  Maintain unobstructed access along utility easements, private roads, and FM highways; comply with
  TxDOT sight-distance requirements.
* **Grubbing Services**
  Excavate roots, stumps, and subterranean debris after tree clearing to ensure stable soils for
  slabs, tanks, or pipe-laying.
* **Home & Lot Clearing**
  Selective clearing around residences—improve defensible space, enhance curb appeal, and comply
  with HOA or POA covenants.

## Storm Cleanup Services

Specialized operations aimed at restoring properties and environments affected by natural events,
neglect, or general debris accumulation. These services include flood cleanup, which involves the
prompt removal of water, damaged materials, and contaminants to restore safety and habitability;
storm cleanup, which focuses on the immediate clearance of fallen trees, debris, and structural
damage following severe weather; and general property cleanup, which ensures properties are
maintained in a clean, safe, and visually appealing condition. Each service is executed with
attention to health, safety, and environmental standards.
* **Flood Cleanup **Rapid and thorough cleanup after flooding, restoring safety and usability to

Meshy 3D models are the most likely to print — watertight, manifold, and ready to slice on the first

###### Welcome to Morven Industrial Limited

## Delivering Excellence, Innovation, and Value

Morven Industrial Limited is a value-driven EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) company
dedicated to serving the West African region with unmatched professionalism and expertise. We
provide a wide range of engineering services and product distribution to industries such as oil and
gas, manufacturing, marine, power generation, IT, and more.

Through our robust partnerships with globally reputable original equipment manufacturers, we deliver
quality and cost-effective solutions that meet your needs—on time and within budget. Our commitment
to international standards and best industry practices ensures safety, reliability, and excellence
in every project.

[ Shop With Us ][154]

## What We do

At Morven Industrial Limited, we offer a comprehensive range of services and products designed to
meet the diverse needs of our clients:

Engineering Services

End-to-end solutions in design, construction, and maintenance for oil and gas, power generation,
manufacturing, and marine sectors.

Procurement

Reliable sourcing of high-quality materials and equipment from leading original equipment
manufacturers around the globe.

Construction Management

Expertise in project execution and construction management, ensuring projects are completed on
schedule and within budget.

Product Distribution

Supply of specialized products, including industrial machinery, spare parts, and tools for various
industries.

IT Solutions

Advanced IT services tailored for industrial applications and system integration.

Marine Solutions

Products and services for vessel maintenance, repairs, and marine operations.

## Delivering Excellence, Innovation, and Value

Morven Industrial Limited is a value-driven EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) company
dedicated to serving the West African region with unmatched professionalism and expertise. We
provide a wide range of engineering services and product distribution to industries such as oil and
gas, manufacturing, marine, power generation, IT, and more.

Through our robust partnerships with globally reputable original equipment manufacturers, we deliver
quality and cost-effective solutions that meet your needs—on time and within budget. Our commitment
to international standards and best industry practices ensures safety, reliability, and excellence
in every project.

About Us

## About Alpha Marketing

Established in the year 1961, we, Alpha Marketing have been efficiently serving the needs of the
buyers in Indian market with quality range of products. Our firm has earned remarkable reputation by
consistently supplying products under the brand name of "Hylite". We are very well acknowledged
across various markets around the world as a Manufacturer, Supplier, Importer, Wholesaler and
Distributor. We have a versatile range of products which includes Airless Paint Sprayer, Airless
Painting Machine, Airless Putty Sprayer, Airless Spray Machine, Airless Paint Spray Gun, Grouting
Pump, Wall Putty Spray Machine & Curve Stone painting Machine and other Painting Tools.

Adhering to stringent quality norms while undertaking our manufacturing processes. Our pure range in
painting tools guarantees 100% bristle of optimum quality that is carefully formulated & blended.
Its handle is either hardwood or polythelene which is well balanced as well as has very comfortable
working grip. Each part of the brush including epoxy, ferrule, nails etc. is carefully chosen &
handcrafted into a good quality brush.

We are also offering rollers for different types of paint as well as every type of surface. We also
deal in variety of accessories such as extension rods, paint holding trays, etc. along with sundry
items like scrapers, wire scratch brushes, and block brushes (available in different sizes).

## About Alpha Marketing

Established in the year 1961, we, Alpha Marketing have been efficiently serving the needs of the
buyers in Indian market with quality range of products. Our firm has earned remarkable reputation by
consistently supplying products under the brand name of "Hylite". We are very well acknowledged
across various markets around the world as a Manufacturer, Supplier, Importer, Wholesaler and
Distributor. We have a versatile range of products which includes Airless Paint Sprayer, Airless
Painting Machine, Airless Putty Sprayer, Airless Spray Machine, Airless Paint Spray Gun, Grouting
Pump, Wall Putty Spray Machine & Curve Stone painting Machine and other Painting Tools.

Adhering to stringent quality norms while undertaking our manufacturing processes. Our pure range in
painting tools guarantees 100% bristle of optimum quality that is carefully formulated & blended.
Its handle is either hardwood or polythelene which is well balanced as well as has very comfortable
working grip. Each part of the brush including epoxy, ferrule, nails etc. is carefully chosen &
handcrafted into a good quality brush.

We are also offering rollers for different types of paint as well as every type of surface. We also
deal in variety of accessories such as extension rods, paint holding trays, etc. along with sundry
items like scrapers, wire scratch brushes, and block brushes (available in different sizes).

## FAQ’s

What is thermoplastic road marking paint and why is it better than regular paint?

Thermoplastic road marking paint is a heat-applied material that bonds strongly to road surfaces and
lasts years without fading. Regular paint fades within months on busy roads and needs frequent
repainting. Thermoplastic dries in minutes, reflects light at night through embedded glass beads,
and withstands heavy traffic and harsh weather.

How long do Prime Roads thermoplastic markings last?

Prime Roads thermoplastic road marking paint is engineered for maximum durability under heavy
traffic and harsh weather conditions. On highways and high-traffic urban roads, our markings
typically last 3 to 5 years depending on traffic volume, surface preparation, and climate
conditions.

Does Prime Roads supply road marking materials across all of India?

Yes. Prime Roads operates 5 manufacturing units and maintains 30+ warehouses strategically located
across India, enabling reliable pan-India delivery of thermoplastic road marking paint, glass beads,
kerb paints, and other road marking materials. We supply to government highway projects,
construction firms, and road marking contractors across all major cities and states. We also export
to 10+ countries including UAE, UK, USA, South Africa, Nepal, and Sri Lanka.

What certifications do Prime Roads products hold?

Prime Roads products are certified to the highest industry standards. We hold ISO 14001:2015
environmental management certification and are approved by the Indian Roads Congress (IRC), ensuring
our thermoplastic road marking materials meet all national road safety and quality specifications.

How can I get a quote or place an order with Prime Roads?
Getting a quote from Prime Roads is simple. You can reach us through any of the following:
**Phone:** +91 98713 10022 or +91 91768 00400
**Email:** sales@primeroads.com
**Online:** Fill the enquiry form at [primeroads.com/contact-us][44]
Our team typically responds within 24 hours. For bulk orders, project-specific requirements, or
export enquiries, please call us directly. We supply to contractors, government agencies, and
construction firms across India and internationally.

## Key Features

### Quick Drying

These paints dry quickly, reducing the time vehicles need to be diverted from freshly painted areas.

### Environment-friendly

These paints minimize harmful emissions, contributing to better air quality and environmental
sustainability.

### Good Visibility

Yellow, white, and fluorescent orange enhance visibility, crucial in dim light or bad weather.

## FAQ’s

What is thermoplastic road marking paint and why is it better than regular paint?

Thermoplastic road marking paint is a heat-applied material that bonds strongly to road surfaces and
lasts years without fading. Regular paint fades within months on busy roads and needs frequent
repainting. Thermoplastic dries in minutes, reflects light at night through embedded glass beads,
and withstands heavy traffic and harsh weather.

How long do Prime Roads thermoplastic markings last?

Prime Roads thermoplastic road marking paint is engineered for maximum durability under heavy
traffic and harsh weather conditions. On highways and high-traffic urban roads, our markings
typically last 3 to 5 years depending on traffic volume, surface preparation, and climate
conditions.

Does Prime Roads supply road marking materials across all of India?

Yes. Prime Roads operates 5 manufacturing units and maintains 30+ warehouses strategically located
across India, enabling reliable pan-India delivery of thermoplastic road marking paint, glass beads,
kerb paints, and other road marking materials. We supply to government highway projects,
construction firms, and road marking contractors across all major cities and states. We also export
to 10+ countries including UAE, UK, USA, South Africa, Nepal, and Sri Lanka.

What certifications do Prime Roads products hold?

Prime Roads products are certified to the highest industry standards. We hold ISO 14001:2015
environmental management certification and are approved by the Indian Roads Congress (IRC), ensuring
our thermoplastic road marking materials meet all national road safety and quality specifications.

How can I get a quote or place an order with Prime Roads?
Getting a quote from Prime Roads is simple. You can reach us through any of the following:
**Phone:** +91 98713 10022 or +91 91768 00400
**Email:** sales@primeroads.com
**Online:** Fill the enquiry form at [primeroads.com/contact-us][44]
Our team typically responds within 24 hours. For bulk orders, project-specific requirements, or
export enquiries, please call us directly. We supply to contractors, government agencies, and
construction firms across India and internationally.

**Promark** is a manufacturer of **thermoplastic material and operates in the Roads and Highways**
sector especially the Road Safety space. **Thermoplastic Road Marking Material (TRM)** is a hot
applied resin based material supplied in a dry mix powder form and is used in developed countries
for road marking. TRM gives high performance and cost effectiveness as it offers extremely high
visibility and durability throughout the life of the line. These retro reflective markings are now
mandatory for National / Major Highways and are widely accepted by the departments involved in road
construction, instead of conventional non-reflective cold applied markings.

While **Promark** supplies its products pan-India and exports to neighbouring countries, the
majority of sales is to **National Highways Authority of India (NHAI)** road contractors, road
construction companies and road painting contractors. The company is also listed on Business to
Business (B2B) platforms such as Indiamart.

#### ABOUT US:

**PROMARK SAFETY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED** incorporated in 2008 under the Companies Act, 1956 and
having its registered office at Bungalow No.16, Second Floor Nizamuddin East, New Delhi, India and
being run by its Directors Arjun Anand and Meenakshi Anand , both of whom are engineers with
longstanding experience in varied fields.

## Thermoplastic Road Marking

## Material Manufacturer

**Regent Tek Americas LLC** offers a comprehensive range of durable, high-performance pavement
marking solutions for all types of roadway applications. Our unique and exclusive thermoplastic
product, **LIQUID MILE MARK™**, has revolutionized the road marking industry.

With a team of experienced chemists from around the world and top-quality materials sourced
globally, **LIQUID MILE MARK™** is a superior pavement marking solution tested and approved for
government, public works, and private roads. This exclusive formulation enhances performance,
durability, and application in any climate.

Our products are designed to provide quality, consistency, and reliability on pavements, regardless
of whether it's day or night, dry or rainy, or any other condition, utilizing materials sourced from
reliable and secure outlets both domestically and globally.

#### Frequent questions and answers for Retroreflectometer

## FAQ

Which type of retroreflectometer can you supply?

Zhenjiang Rays Traffic Tech Co.,Ltd. is a reliable manufacturer of high-precision retroreflectometer
in China. With advanced R&D center, experienced production team and strict QC management, we can
produce and supply higher accuracy retroreflectometers as below:
1. Road marking retroreflectometer
2. Traffic sign retroreflectometer
3. Reflective sheet retroreflectometer
4. Raised pavement marker retroreflectometer

Why do large pavement marking paint factories need horizontal retroreflectometers?

If you’re a leading road marking paint manufacturer in you countries, enjoying excellent company
reputation and brand recognition.
-With portable horizontal retroreflectometer by hand, you can continuously monitor your road marking
coating’s reflectivity and adjust coating formula in time.
-You can equip your road marking paint distributors, dealers and sales with horizontal
retroreflectometers so they can demonstrate the retroreflective properties of your coatings to
potential buyers, allowing customers to understand the advantages of your coatings more intuitively.
-You can use the horizontal retroreflectometer as a promotional tool, for example, offering a free
road marking retroreflectometer with the purchase of 200Mt of hot-melt road marking paint once time.
-After-sale person also need to be equipped with a portable horizontal retroreflectometer. When
visiting customer’s road marking construction sites, they can assist customers in measuring the
retroreflectivity of newly painted road markings to improve the acceptance rate. This also allows
for better collection of data on the reflectivity of your company’s coatings, enabling better
improvement of coating performance.

studs.

What's the language of retroreflectometer display?

The language of retroreflectometer is Chinese, English(optional), other language customized. Real
time voice broadcast language can be Chinese and English.

Does your retroreflectometer support GPS?

GPS is optional function for RAYS TRAFFIC portable horizontal retroreflectometers and vertical
retroreflectometers, 80% of our customers will need this function, we will install if you need. The
GPS information will be shown on the homepage, measurement result, on the printed test results page
and in the exported data sheet.

We're searing for high-performance retroreflectometer.

RAYS TRAFFIC has always been committed to supplying high-precision retroreflectometers for road
safety inspection and quality control. Our product range includes road marking retroreflectometers,
road sign retroreflectometers, and raised pavement marker retroreflectometers, all designed for
reliable performance in demanding field conditions.
Key Advantages of RAYS TRAFFIC Retroreflectometers:
1. Highly Stable Light Source
The optical system delivers uniform illumination with minimal light attenuation. Long-term operation
maintains stable color temperature without noticeable drift, ensuring consistent measurement
accuracy over long-term use.
2. High-Precision Photoelectric Sensors
Excellent linearity and strong signal capture capability for highly accurate retroreflection
measurement results.
3. Industrial-Grade MCU Control System
Offer fast data processing speed and strong anti-interference capability for stable operation in
complex environments.
4. Long-Life Industrial Lithium Battery
Powered by durable industrial lithium batteries with long operating time and high charge-discharge
cycle life, suitable for continuous field inspections.
5. Compliance with International Standards
Manufactured in strict accordance with International standards such as EN1436 and ASTM E1710, ASTM
E1709, EN12899, EN1643, ASTM1696,etc. The instruments can pass official metrology calibration and
deliver accuracy comparable to leading retroreflectometers from Switzerland and Denmark.
6. Designed for Harsh Outdoor Environments
Each device undergoes comprehensive testing, including high and low temperature testing, humidity
testing, drop testing, and EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing. The instruments are engineered
for highways, construction sites, rainy conditions, snow, and other harsh outdoor environments.
7.Smart Data Management Functions
Integrated with Bluetooth wireless transmission, data export, on-site bluetooth printer, and
large-capacity data storage. The user interface is intuitive and designed around real inspection
workflows for easier operation in the working sites.
8.Reliable Manufacturing and After-Sales Support
With in-house manufacturing and long-term stock availability of core spare parts, RAYS TRAFFIC
provides stable product supply and dependable long-term maintenance support for global customers.

Who will need these reflection meter?

There’re four type of customers need to prepare these retroreflectometers.
-Pavement marking coating manufacturers, glass beads factories, reflective sheet/clothes/materials
producers, road sign suppliers, road studs factories. You will need portable retroreflection meter
to measure your product in workshop’s lab.
-Road safety measurement instrument distributors, if you resell other brand retroreflectometers,
such as famous Delta, Zehntner, Roadvista, RetroTek, Easylux brand, you can consider RAYS TRAFFIC as
an alternative retroreflectometer supplier.
-Third party inspection agents, government transportation department, University transportation
departments or labs.
-Traffic safety-related products resellers, suppliers, appliers, contractors or applicators for road
marking, traffic sign, reflective sheet, road studs.

If OEM customization is available?

Rays Traffic provide pavement marking retroreflectometer and road sign retroreflectometer OEM for
customers all over the world. We have extensive experience working with brand companies. Therefore,
we have manufactured the retroreflectometers in black/red/orange colors. We can display your brand

customers customize Portuguese, Korean, Russianvlanguages. If you need other language in your
country, we can further design your language version.

#### Frequent questions and answers for Retroreflectometer

## FAQ

Which type of retroreflectometer can you supply?

Zhenjiang Rays Traffic Tech Co.,Ltd. is a reliable manufacturer of high-precision retroreflectometer
in China. With advanced R&D center, experienced production team and strict QC management, we can
produce and supply higher accuracy retroreflectometers as below:
1. Road marking retroreflectometer
2. Traffic sign retroreflectometer
3. Reflective sheet retroreflectometer
4. Raised pavement marker retroreflectometer

Why do large pavement marking paint factories need horizontal retroreflectometers?

If you’re a leading road marking paint manufacturer in you countries, enjoying excellent company
reputation and brand recognition.
-With portable horizontal retroreflectometer by hand, you can continuously monitor your road marking
coating’s reflectivity and adjust coating formula in time.
-You can equip your road marking paint distributors, dealers and sales with horizontal
retroreflectometers so they can demonstrate the retroreflective properties of your coatings to
potential buyers, allowing customers to understand the advantages of your coatings more intuitively.
-You can use the horizontal retroreflectometer as a promotional tool, for example, offering a free
road marking retroreflectometer with the purchase of 200Mt of hot-melt road marking paint once time.
-After-sale person also need to be equipped with a portable horizontal retroreflectometer. When
visiting customer’s road marking construction sites, they can assist customers in measuring the
retroreflectivity of newly painted road markings to improve the acceptance rate. This also allows
for better collection of data on the reflectivity of your company’s coatings, enabling better
improvement of coating performance.

studs.

What's the language of retroreflectometer display?

The language of retroreflectometer is Chinese, English(optional), other language customized. Real
time voice broadcast language can be Chinese and English.

Does your retroreflectometer support GPS?

GPS is optional function for RAYS TRAFFIC portable horizontal retroreflectometers and vertical
retroreflectometers, 80% of our customers will need this function, we will install if you need. The
GPS information will be shown on the homepage, measurement result, on the printed test results page
and in the exported data sheet.

We're searing for high-performance retroreflectometer.

RAYS TRAFFIC has always been committed to supplying high-precision retroreflectometers for road
safety inspection and quality control. Our product range includes road marking retroreflectometers,
road sign retroreflectometers, and raised pavement marker retroreflectometers, all designed for
reliable performance in demanding field conditions.
Key Advantages of RAYS TRAFFIC Retroreflectometers:
1. Highly Stable Light Source
The optical system delivers uniform illumination with minimal light attenuation. Long-term operation
maintains stable color temperature without noticeable drift, ensuring consistent measurement
accuracy over long-term use.
2. High-Precision Photoelectric Sensors
Excellent linearity and strong signal capture capability for highly accurate retroreflection
measurement results.
3. Industrial-Grade MCU Control System
Offer fast data processing speed and strong anti-interference capability for stable operation in
complex environments.
4. Long-Life Industrial Lithium Battery
Powered by durable industrial lithium batteries with long operating time and high charge-discharge
cycle life, suitable for continuous field inspections.
5. Compliance with International Standards
Manufactured in strict accordance with International standards such as EN1436 and ASTM E1710, ASTM
E1709, EN12899, EN1643, ASTM1696,etc. The instruments can pass official metrology calibration and
deliver accuracy comparable to leading retroreflectometers from Switzerland and Denmark.
6. Designed for Harsh Outdoor Environments
Each device undergoes comprehensive testing, including high and low temperature testing, humidity
testing, drop testing, and EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing. The instruments are engineered
for highways, construction sites, rainy conditions, snow, and other harsh outdoor environments.
7.Smart Data Management Functions
Integrated with Bluetooth wireless transmission, data export, on-site bluetooth printer, and
large-capacity data storage. The user interface is intuitive and designed around real inspection
workflows for easier operation in the working sites.
8.Reliable Manufacturing and After-Sales Support
With in-house manufacturing and long-term stock availability of core spare parts, RAYS TRAFFIC
provides stable product supply and dependable long-term maintenance support for global customers.

Who will need these reflection meter?

There’re four type of customers need to prepare these retroreflectometers.
-Pavement marking coating manufacturers, glass beads factories, reflective sheet/clothes/materials
producers, road sign suppliers, road studs factories. You will need portable retroreflection meter
to measure your product in workshop’s lab.
-Road safety measurement instrument distributors, if you resell other brand retroreflectometers,
such as famous Delta, Zehntner, Roadvista, RetroTek, Easylux brand, you can consider RAYS TRAFFIC as
an alternative retroreflectometer supplier.
-Third party inspection agents, government transportation department, University transportation
departments or labs.
-Traffic safety-related products resellers, suppliers, appliers, contractors or applicators for road
marking, traffic sign, reflective sheet, road studs.

If OEM customization is available?

Rays Traffic provide pavement marking retroreflectometer and road sign retroreflectometer OEM for
customers all over the world. We have extensive experience working with brand companies. Therefore,
we have manufactured the retroreflectometers in black/red/orange colors. We can display your brand

customers customize Portuguese, Korean, Russianvlanguages. If you need other language in your
country, we can further design your language version.

safety solution provider in China. With two modern production bases located in Guangzhou and
Zhanjiang, Guangdong Province, we specialize in manufacturing high-performance Thermoplastic Road
Marking Paint, Two-Component Road Marking Paint, Reflective Glass Beads, Road Marking Machines, and
complete road marking solutions.

and Private Sectors in Gujarat.

We manufacture and install varied types of Signage, Aluminium Sign boards, ACP Sign board, Road
Safety Signage, Hot Applied Road Marking, Road Studs / Pavement Marker/ Cat Eye, Median Marker,
Flexible Median Marker, Delineator, Single Beam Crash Barrier, Double Beam Crash Barrier, Thrie Beam

## QUALITY ASSURANCE

understand the need for modern businesses to create their own individual identity and differentiate
themselves from the rest, which is why we are right for you. Along with our various sign products we
offer complete installation of all signs that we sell. All sign installations are completed by our
in-house installation crew in order to maintain our strict quality standards

From beginning to end each client is treated with utmost priority and respect. A dedicated project
manager will be able to guide you from the design, commercial and finally the installation of your
very order, ensuring that every order we sell meets and exceeds the expectations of our customers.
Our engineers are skilled in knowing exactly what is required in order to produce quality,
long-lasting relationship with customers.

We founded on the belief that clients deserve high quality products at cost effective prices,
supported by service with excellence. Our established track record of satisfied customers, both
large and small, proves this. Being a progressive company, we constantly strive to find new concepts
for our clients; we are continually developing new products and an area of the factory is dedicated
to design and prototyping with a view to undertaking roll outs for the retail industry. We believe
much of our success comes developing a clear understanding of our customer’s needs both financially
and creatively. With us you can be confident that every aspect of your project, from design through
production to installation, will be carefully executed by our professional, skilled and friendly
team.

[ +373 (69) 27 66 31 ][15]

RoadService – Experți în marcaje rutiere și producția de indicatoare rutiere.

Zi de zi pe drumuri, în siguranță cu voi

RoadService — lider în domeniul infrastructurii rutiere, specializat în aplicarea marcajelor, precum
și în producția și vânzarea indicatoarelor rutiere. Garantăm calitatea superioară a produselor și
lucrărilor, respectând pe deplin standardele de siguranță.

Apelând la noi, puteți comanda producția indicatoarelor rutiere sau serviciile de aplicare a
marcajelor. Vom găsi soluțiile optime pentru organizarea eficientă a traficului rutier.

Scopul nostru este să asigurăm siguranța și confortul pe drumuri pentru șoferi și pietoni.

Serviciile RoadService

### Aplicarea marcajelor rutiere

Marcaje pentru toate tipurile de drumuri, inclusiv treceri de pietoni și benzi de circulație.

[
Vezi detalii
][16]

### Producția indicatoarelor rutiere

Asigurăm vizibilitatea ridicată a semnelor pentru siguranță în orice moment.

[
Vezi detalii
][17]
De ce să ne alegeți

### 40 de ani de experiență

Asigurăm vizibilitate ridicată a marcajelor și indicatoarelor pentru siguranță în orice moment

### Cele mai bune prețuri pe piață

Oferim calitate excelentă la prețuri rezonabile.

### Materiale de calitate și testate

Produsele noastre sunt realizate folosind doar materiale verificate, garantând astfel fiabilitate și
durabilitate

### Tehnologii avansate

Utilizăm cele mai noi tehnologii și echipamente pentru a oferi servicii de cea mai înaltă calitate

### Marcaje rutiere de orice complexitate

Executăm marcaje rutiere de orice complexitate cu precizie și fiabilitate

Etapele colaborării cu RoadService

Înainte de a începe fabricarea indicatoarelor sau aplicarea marcajelor, este important să înțelegem
în detaliu întreaga procedură. Toate elementele de marcaj și semnalizare trebuie să regleze
circulația vehiculelor și pietonilor, respectând în același timp standardele de siguranță rutieră
stabilite.

[ Proiectele noastre ][18]
01.

Lăsați o cerere pe site-ul nostru sau la telefon – vom lua legătura cu dumneavoastră cât mai curând
posibil

Un expert al nostru se va deplasa la fața locului pentru o evaluare detaliată a situației și pentru
a pregăti planul de lucru

03.

Semnăm un contract, clarificând toate detaliile proiectului, termenele și condițiile de executare

04.

Echipa noastră profesionistă începe lucrările, respectând cu maximă precizie cerințele stabilite

05.

Veți primi un proiect executat cu mare atenție la detalii, complet conform cerințelor dumneavoastră

# Driving Innovation in Pavement Markings

**Safer. Smarter. Sustainable.**
Founded in 2023 by road marking material manufacturers, TMMA is committed to accelerating road
marking industry innovation and support for automotive technologies that improve safety for all road
users. Powered by the energy and talent found in the world’s diverse road marking manufacturing
industry, TMMA members seek to bring leading edge technology to transform the way road markings are
installed, monitored, and maintained to ensure a safer, smarter, and sustainable future.

[Join TMMA][50]

## Our Key Focus Areas
* Driving Adoption of Machine Vision Technologies
* Leading on Sustainable Pavement Marking Material
* Enhancing Safety for Vulnerable Road Users
* Partnering To Ensure Compliant Road Markings

### Setting the Standard in Road Safety

From manufacturing to execution — delivering reliable, compliant, and long-lasting solutions.

ISO 9001:2015 Certified • NHAI, PWD & Municipal Contractor

[Get Quote][13]
[Services][14]

**Saisurface Thermomark Pvt Ltd is an ISO 9001:2015 certified road safety and thermoplastic road
marking contractor, manufacturer, and supplier based in Maharashtra, India. The company specializes
in delivering end-to-end road marking and traffic safety infrastructure solutions for National
Highways, State Highways, Municipal Corporations, Smart City projects, industrial zones, airports,
and commercial developments across India.**

**With extensive industry experience and a highly skilled execution team, we undertake large-scale
road safety projects including thermoplastic road marking, highway lane marking, zebra crossings,
cat eyes and road studs installation, traffic sign boards supply and installation, divider and kerb
painting, and complete road safety execution as per IRC and MORTH standards.**

**In addition to contracting services, we manufacture thermoplastic road marking materials and
supply a comprehensive range of road safety products such as reflective road studs, speed breakers,
traffic signage, delineators, barriers, mirrors, parking safety equipment, and traffic management
systems. Our integrated approach enables us to provide reliable, high-quality solutions tailored to
the requirements of government agencies, contractors, builders, and infrastructure developers.**

**As an MSME-registered, GST-compliant private limited company, we are committed to quality, safety,
timely execution, and customer satisfaction. Our mission is to enhance road safety and traffic
management through durable materials, advanced technology, and professional project execution.**

**We proudly serve clients across India and welcome large-scale infrastructure and highway
projects.**

Silikal India specializes in high-performance MMA-based industrial and commercial floor coatings,
offering durable, nonslip, and hygienic solutions tailored to diverse industries. Silikal floors
combine quality and dedication for transforming spaces with long-lasting floors.

## History of Silikal

   Since 1951, our core business has been our flooring, floor coating services, and industrial
floors based on reactive resins. We have been doing the basics for you for decades, with a
background in screed construction. We decided a good 60 years ago to concentrate on developing and
manufacturing floor coatings based on MMA resins.

We provide high-performing MMA flooring solutions for industries that can withstand high traffic and

non-slip surface that withstands daily wear and tear, spills, and foot traffic.

Upgrade your home with our premium residential floor coating services. Designed for both style and
durability, our coatings protect your floors while enhancing their appearance.

Silikal MMA floor coatings meet hygiene requirements for industries such as healthcare, food
processing, and pharmaceuticals by preventing water ingress and mold growth. Because they are
seamless and easy to clean, these coatings ensure compliance with regulatory standards even in wet
or humid conditions, providing a safe and sanitary environment.

##### Load Bearing

Silikal MMA floor coatings are engineered for heavy loads and high traffic, ideal for industrial
spaces like warehouses and factories. They resist cracks, deformation, and delamination under
forklifts and trucks. With rapid curing, operations resume quickly, minimizing downtime. Silikal
delivers unmatched durability for demanding environments.

#### Easy To Clean

One of the standout benefits of Silikal MMA floor coatings is their ease of cleaning and
maintenance. The smooth, seamless surface prevents dirt, grime, and spills from penetrating, making
routine cleaning quick and effortless. Whether you're dealing with everyday dust or tougher stains,
a simple wipe or wash can restore the flooring to its pristine and hygienic condition.

##### Temperature

Silikal MMA coatings performs exceptionally well in a wide range of temperatures, making it suitable
for environments such as cold storage or hot industrial kitchens. It also can be done at 0°C to
-25°C and can cure quickly at that temperature. Silikal MMA floor coatings do not degrade, bubble,
or peel even at extremely high temperatures.

#### Anti-Skid

Silikal MMA floor coatings provide exceptional anti-skid properties, which enhance safety. With
anti-slip additives, they ensure slip resistance for both light and heavy traffic areas, reducing
the risk of slips and falls in wet or oily conditions. Durable, reliable, and safe flooring
solutions for industries like food processing, healthcare, retail, and automotive. 

##### Repairable

Silikal MMA floor coatings can be repaired easily by patching the damaged or cracked areas with
compatible Silikal MMA materials. The advantage of being easily repairable is ensuring that your
flooring remains in top condition. Because MMA resins are fast-curing if there is any damage or
wear, repairs can be performed quickly and efficiently. 

#### Durable

Silikal floor coatings are built to last, withstanding heavy foot traffic, machine and trolley
movement, chemical spills, and harsh conditions. They provide long-lasting protection, ensuring your
floors stay in top shape for years. Provides an extremely durable surface that resists wear and
tear, ensuring long-term cost savings and reduced maintenance requirements. 

##### Aesthetic

Silikal MMA floor coatings not only provide superior durability and functionality but also offer a
visually appealing finish that can enhance any space. Because these coatings are available in a wide
range of colors, textures, and finishes, they can be customized to match any design aesthetic, from
sleek modern styles to traditional looks.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Find answers to the most common questions about our products, services, and solutions. If you
don’t see your question here, feel free to contact us directly!**

### What are floor coatings?

Floor coatings are protective or decorative layers applied to floors to protect the base structure
like concrete or other substances from wear and tear and improve the life of building structures.
They are one of best option for industries and commercial spaces as they provide stronger and
long-lasting protection than normal floorings. Due to their resistance to wear, abrasion, chemicals,
moisture, and other environmental factors, they are ideal for various applications such as
industries, cold storage facilities, garages, basements, patios, retail spaces, offices, factories,
warehouses, hospitals, gyms, and food-processing plants. They offer key benefits, including improved
resistance to wear and tear caused by machines trolley and heavy foot traffic, stains and damages,
safety with anti-slip options, customizable aesthetics, and easier maintenance. The choice of floor
coating depends on the specific needs of the space, such as traffic levels, exposure to harsh
conditions, and desired visual appeal.

### Why should I consider floor coating services for my property?

Floor coatings offers several benefits, including:
* Increased durability and longevity of floors
* Enhanced aesthetics and polished appearance
* Resistance to stains, scratches, and chemical spills
* Easier cleaning and maintenance
* Improved safety by providing slip-resistant surfaces
* LOW VOC emissions and UV resistant floors

### How long does a floor coating last?

The lifespan of a floor coating can vary depending on the type of coating, traffic levels, and
maintenance.  MMA coatings may last up to 20 years or more with proper care.

### What is the time taken for application of MMA floor coatings?

MMA floor coatings can be applied overnight. MMA coatings have a fast-curing time, often allowing
for foot traffic in just a few hours. This makes MMA coatings ideal for businesses where minimal
downtime is critical.

### Do I need to remove my existing floor for floor coating application?

In most cases, removing your existing floor is unnecessary when applying MMA floor coating. This
versatile coating is designed to adhere to various substrates, including concrete, wood, tiles,
marble, and granite. However, if the floor has severe cracks, delamination, or uneven areas, repairs
must be carried out before applying the coating.

In extreme cases, partial removal of damaged sections may be required, but complete floor removal is
rarely needed. Preparation is key: ensure the floor is thoroughly cleaned, free of grease, oil, and
dirt, and completely dry before proceeding with the MMA application.

### Why floor coatings are required in an industry?

In industries, floors must withstand the toughest conditions, including heavy equipment movement

## What We Do at Sportsmark

At Sportsmark, we combine high-quality products with outstanding customer service. Our [sports
ground equipment][102] includes everything from long jump equipment and throwing cages to beach
volleyball sets and multi-use games areas. We also specialise in golf course supplies, helping
greenkeepers and groundsmen maintain pristine playing conditions. If you are wondering where to buy
[cricket equipment][103] or [golf course supplies][104], for example, Sportsmark provides a one-stop
solution with nationwide delivery.

Our services go beyond supply. We offer sports ground construction and maintenance, whether it’s
building a cricket wicket, creating a long jump pit, or refurbishing an all-weather pitch. From line
marking and resurfacing sports hall floors to installing dugouts and shelters, we support facilities
of every size, from small community clubs to Premiership football teams.

### **For Contractors**

Contractors trust Sportsmark because of our unrivalled selection of sports and safety products. From
installing a cricket wicket or laying down track and field equipment to providing a durable white
line marking machine for ongoing site use, we ensure your projects meet the highest standards. Our
range also covers groundsman’s tools, greenkeeper essentials, and the largest choice of [line
marking equipment][105] in the UK.

### **For Colleges and Universities**

We have a long history of working with schools, colleges, and universities, providing both [supply
and construction services][106]. Sportsmark can deliver a cricket cage, a long jump run-up and pit,
or an entire suite of athletic training equipment. We also supply grass marking paint, sports hall
refurbishments, and traffic safety solutions for car parks. Our team makes it simple to create and
maintain safe, professional spaces for sport and study.

## What We Do at Sportsmark

At Sportsmark, we combine high-quality products with outstanding customer service. Our [sports
ground equipment][102] includes everything from long jump equipment and throwing cages to beach
volleyball sets and multi-use games areas. We also specialise in golf course supplies, helping
greenkeepers and groundsmen maintain pristine playing conditions. If you are wondering where to buy
[cricket equipment][103] or [golf course supplies][104], for example, Sportsmark provides a one-stop
solution with nationwide delivery.

Our services go beyond supply. We offer sports ground construction and maintenance, whether it’s
building a cricket wicket, creating a long jump pit, or refurbishing an all-weather pitch. From line
marking and resurfacing sports hall floors to installing dugouts and shelters, we support facilities
of every size, from small community clubs to Premiership football teams.

### **For Contractors**

Contractors trust Sportsmark because of our unrivalled selection of sports and safety products. From
installing a cricket wicket or laying down track and field equipment to providing a durable white
line marking machine for ongoing site use, we ensure your projects meet the highest standards. Our
range also covers groundsman’s tools, greenkeeper essentials, and the largest choice of [line
marking equipment][105] in the UK.

### **For Colleges and Universities**

We have a long history of working with schools, colleges, and universities, providing both [supply
and construction services][106]. Sportsmark can deliver a cricket cage, a long jump run-up and pit,
or an entire suite of athletic training equipment. We also supply grass marking paint, sports hall
refurbishments, and traffic safety solutions for car parks. Our team makes it simple to create and
maintain safe, professional spaces for sport and study.
