**WHO WE ARE**

# **SWARCO**

**The Better Way. Every Day.**



**SINCE 1969.**

You encounter us every day on the roads of our planet. Our products, systems, services and turnkey
solutions make travel safe and convenient for people on the move. In the spirit of SWARCO founder
Manfred Swarovski we pride ourselves in being agile, innovative, reliable and trustworthy; and will
not hesitate to go the extra mile for you.

## read more

The traffic technology group SWARCO – headquartered in Wattens near Innsbruck, Austria – has an
international network of production facilities, offices, and partners across the globe. Together, we
offer one of the most complete solution portfolios for road marking, signage, urban traffic
management, parking, highway and tunnel management, public transport, and street lighting. We
connect vehicles with the road infrastructure, help in setting up charging infrastructure to boost
electro-mobility, and offer modular and holistic solutions that support tomorrow’s mobility and make
our communities more livable.

SWARCO’s 5,300 transportation experts look forward to collaborating with you
to craft a solution to meet your individual requirements.

What can we do for you today?





**WHAT WE DO**

# Our Expertise

We offer Road Marking Systems, Intelligent Transportation Systems and Industrial
Solutions. Browse below and discover the full portfolio.

[**Road Marking Systems**][90]

Safely guiding the way for humans and machines.

[**Intelligent Transportation Systems**][91]

Your trusted partner for reliable mobility solutions.

[**Indusferica**][92]

Filter & filler beads as well as blasting media for industrial solutions.

**WHO WE ARE**

# **SWARCO**

**The Better Way. Every Day.**



**SINCE 1969.**

You encounter us every day on the roads of our planet. Our products, systems, services and turnkey
solutions make travel safe and convenient for people on the move. In the spirit of SWARCO founder
Manfred Swarovski we pride ourselves in being agile, innovative, reliable and trustworthy; and will
not hesitate to go the extra mile for you.

## read more

The traffic technology group SWARCO – headquartered in Wattens near Innsbruck, Austria – has an
international network of production facilities, offices, and partners across the globe. Together, we
offer one of the most complete solution portfolios for road marking, signage, urban traffic
management, parking, highway and tunnel management, public transport, and street lighting. We
connect vehicles with the road infrastructure, help in setting up charging infrastructure to boost
electro-mobility, and offer modular and holistic solutions that support tomorrow’s mobility and make
our communities more livable.

SWARCO’s 5,300 transportation experts look forward to collaborating with you
to craft a solution to meet your individual requirements.

What can we do for you today?





**WHAT WE DO**

# Our Expertise

We offer Road Marking Systems, Intelligent Transportation Systems and Industrial
Solutions. Browse below and discover the full portfolio.

[**Road Marking Systems**][90]

Safely guiding the way for humans and machines.

[**Intelligent Transportation Systems**][91]

Your trusted partner for reliable mobility solutions.

[**Indusferica**][92]

Filter & filler beads as well as blasting media for industrial solutions.

## Heavsty Defines Precision in Global Road Marking Solutions

Quality Lead the Future

Heavsty is China's largest manufacturer of road marking machines, dedicated to delivering
world-class road safety solutions to infrastructure projects across the globe. With a factory
covering over **20,000 square meters**, a dedicated service and R&D team of **40 professionals**,
and a total workforce of more than **200 employees**, we combine engineering excellence with
manufacturing scale.

Our product range spans thermoplastic road marking machines, cold spray systems, airport rubber
removal vehicles, hot melt kettles, and large vehicle-mounted road marking equipment — all
engineered to meet the demanding standards of modern road construction projects worldwide.

# 

# Road Marking Machine Manufacturer & Thermoplastic & Cold Paint Road Marking Equipment

Unimark Machines is a leading manufacturer of road marking machines and thermoplastic road marking
equipment designed for modern infrastructure projects.

Our advanced line marking machines are engineered for precision, durability, and high performance in
highways, airports, parking facilities, and industrial safety zones.

We proudly export high-quality road marking equipment to international markets including Australia,
UAE, Africa, USA, and Mexico & many more.

### What We Do

### What We Do & Who We Are

**Universal Enterprises**, an **ISO 9001:2015 certified** company, was established in **1999** and
brings over **25 years** **of industry expertise**, driven by an unwavering commitment to quality
under the **leadership of Mr. Malyadri Muvva**. Backed by dynamic and multi-faceted leadership,
Universal Enterprises **specialize in complete safety equipment, personal protective equipment
(PPE), fire fighting, fire protection systems, road and parking safety products, fall protection
solution and welding safety equipment from leading brands.** Our commitment to safety, compliance
and customer satisfaction makes us a preferred safety solutions partner for factories, construction
sites, warehouses and institutions.

**Universal Enterprises is a trusted industrial safety equipment supplier, service provider,
complete industrial safety solutions for construction and industrial workplace safety applications
across Telangana, Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, Vijayawada Nellore, etc…** We deliver quality products,
expert support and reliable service. Offering complete safety, fire protection, road safety and MEP
solutions across India, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh states. With years of industry experience, we
deliver **quality-certified safety products, professional installation services and reliable after
sales support to industrial, construction, commercial and infrastructure projects.**

With a **dedicated team of 100+ skilled professionals**, we collaborate with renowned global and
national brands to deliver **customized, end-to-end industrial safety solutions**. We proudly serve
thousands of leading companies across India, ensuring **exceptional service quality, timely
execution and competitive pricing** throughout **PAN India**.

Universal Enterprises is your **trusted one stop solution for all industrial needs.**

### What We Do & Who We Are

**Universal Enterprises**, an **ISO 9001:2015 certified** company, was established in **1999** and
brings over **25 years** **of industry expertise**, driven by an unwavering commitment to quality
under the **leadership of Mr. Malyadri Muvva**. Backed by dynamic and multi-faceted leadership,
Universal Enterprises **specialize in complete safety equipment, personal protective equipment
(PPE), fire fighting, fire protection systems, road and parking safety products, fall protection
solution and welding safety equipment from leading brands.** Our commitment to safety, compliance
and customer satisfaction makes us a preferred safety solutions partner for factories, construction
sites, warehouses and institutions.

**Universal Enterprises is a trusted industrial safety equipment supplier, service provider,
complete industrial safety solutions for construction and industrial workplace safety applications
across Telangana, Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, Vijayawada Nellore, etc…** We deliver quality products,
expert support and reliable service. Offering complete safety, fire protection, road safety and MEP
solutions across India, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh states. With years of industry experience, we
deliver **quality-certified safety products, professional installation services and reliable after
sales support to industrial, construction, commercial and infrastructure projects.**

With a **dedicated team of 100+ skilled professionals**, we collaborate with renowned global and
national brands to deliver **customized, end-to-end industrial safety solutions**. We proudly serve
thousands of leading companies across India, ensuring **exceptional service quality, timely
execution and competitive pricing** throughout **PAN India**.

Universal Enterprises is your **trusted one stop solution for all industrial needs.**

## Leading Road Marking Paint Manufacturer & Exporter

500+Projects
50+Countries
10+Years

YNM Safety is among trusted [**MMA resin cold plastic paint manufacturers**][10] in India, producing
ambient-cure 2-component methyl methacrylate systems for airports, parking decks, sports tracks and
specialty surfaces without heating the pavement. As **cold plastic paint manufacturers**, we support
cycle track marking paint manufacturers grades for NMT corridors and smart-city bike lanes, plus
raised sign marking paint manufacturers formulations for pavement symbols, directional arrows and
junction logos — with in-house testing for adhesion, skid resistance and glass-bead retention before
dispatch.

As leading [**hot thermoplastic paint manufacturers**][11], YNM Safety supplies MoRTH 803 and IRC 35
compliant screed and extrusion thermoplastic for NHAI highways, expressways, state PWD packages and
municipal road contracts from our ISO 9001:2015 Hyderabad plant. Our hot thermoplastic road marking
paint is engineered with hydrocarbon resins, titanium dioxide pigments and retro-reflective glass
beads for lane lines, edge markings, zebra crossings and junction layouts — the preferred **NHAI
highway marking paint** for national corridor projects across India and 50+ export markets.

YNM Safety operates as established [**airfield marking paint manufacturers**][12] for civil aviation
infrastructure across India and export programmes. We supply low-VOC waterborne systems aligned with
DGCA and ICAO project needs — trusted airport marking paint manufacturers for runway marking paint
manufacturers packages, taxiway paint manufacturers specifications, apron holding positions and
helipad delineation with batch traceability for EPC and authority tenders.

YNM Safety is a dedicated [**profile marking paint manufacturers**][13] partner for raised rib
lines, shoulder warnings and tactile highway safety zones. We supply raised profile marking paint
manufacturers grades, transverse bar marking paint manufacturers systems for toll approaches and
median alerts, audible vibratory marking paint manufacturers profile lines for driver alertness, and
rumble strips marking paint manufacturers formulations for expressway curves and black-spot
improvement programmes — hot-applied thermoplastic and MMA resin cold plastic options with
MoRTH-aligned technical support.

As [**kerb marking paint manufacturers**][14], YNM Safety formulates waterborne kerb base marking
paint for concrete channel edges, shoulder lines and urban kerb delineation on NHAI highways,
expressway medians and city road packages. Our kerb base paint manufacturers grades meet project
specifications for **NHAI kerb marking paint** with durable adhesion to concrete and asphalt
substrates, standard colour options and documentation suited to state PWD and municipal contracts.

YNM Safety also manufactures [**glow in the dark paint manufacturers**][15] grades —
photoluminescent road marking paint for tunnels, parking decks, metro platforms and emergency egress
routes that charge under ambient light and glow without continuous grid power. [Request a quote][16]
or [contact us][17] for project-specific grades.

## Road Marking Paint Manufacturers — Product Pages

YNM Safety manufactures MMA resin cold plastic, hot thermoplastic, airfield/runway/taxiway marking,
profile/raised profile, transverse bar and rumble strips marking paints, kerb base marking, and
glow-in-the-dark photoluminescent paints — MoRTH/IRC-aligned grades, NHAI tender support and export
from Hyderabad.
